messages.subject: R for Absolute Beginners at D-RUG This Week
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

We will be meeting this Thursday (9/25) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This week Wes will be running a mini-workshop for getting started in R for the first portion of D-RUG:

Been putting off writing your first line of R code? Coming back to R after a long time away? Feeling intimidated by all the technical jargon? This mini-workshop is for you! Come walk step by step through the very basics of R and learn some best practices along the way. At the end we'll introduce you to additional resources where you can learn even more. We can't wait to see you there!

Afterwards we will continue with our open session format!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

See you theRe,
Your Coo[R]dinators
